lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs are organized into approximately nine discernible vertical columns posterior to the gill region, forming a semi-regular grid where inter-column spacing increases in the posterior direction.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, positioning the largest circular clusters as anchor nodes at the grid intersection points.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible along the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient transition from highlights on the superior edge to shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The cephalic region anterior to the gill slits exhibits a high-density field of smaller, high-luminance pixel clusters compared to the lateral flank, and the pectoral fin displays a distinct arrangement of high-contrast blobs in longitudinal rows.
